pollute the air: Cars and factories pollute the air in big cities, so many people wear masks when they go out.
汽車和工廠污染大城市的空氣，所以許多人外出時會戴口罩。
pollute young minds: Some parents worry that violent video games may pollute young minds with the idea that hurting people is fun.
有些家長擔心暴力電玩可能會以「傷害別人很好玩」的想法污染年輕心靈。
polluted rivers: The government spent millions of dollars cleaning polluted rivers so that fish could live in them again.
政府花了數百萬元清理受污染河川，讓魚能再次在河裡生存。
pool resources: The three small schools decided to pool resources so they could buy a bus that all of them could share.
三所小學校決定集中資源，買一輛大家可以共用的校車。
pool money: My classmates and I decided to pool money to buy our teacher a nice birthday present.
我和同學們決定湊錢買一份好的生日禮物送給老師。
pool knowledge: When students pool knowledge in group projects, they can solve problems that no one could solve alone.
學生在小組專題中彙集知識時，能解決沒有人能獨自解決的問題。
a talent pool: Taiwan has a talent pool of skilled engineers, which attracts many tech companies to invest here.
台灣擁有技術純熟工程師的人才庫，吸引許多科技公司來此投資。
a pool of candidates: The company had a pool of candidates to choose from, but only three were invited for a second interview.
公司有一群候選人可供挑選，但只有三人獲邀參加第二次面試。
portion out the food: At the camp, the leader had to portion out the food carefully so that it would last for three days.
在營地裡，領隊必須小心分配食物，讓它能撐三天。
a portion of the profit: The company gives a portion of the profit to charity every year to help poor children.
這家公司每年把一部分利潤捐給慈善機構，幫助貧困兒童。
portion sizes: Restaurants in America are famous for their huge portion sizes, so one meal can often feed two people.
美國的餐廳以份量巨大聞名，所以一份餐常常夠兩個人吃。
portray a character: It took the actor months of practice to portray a character who could neither see nor hear.
這位演員花了好幾個月練習，才飾演一個既看不見也聽不到的角色。
be portrayed as a hero: In the painting, the young soldier is portrayed as a hero riding a white horse in front of his army.
在這幅畫中，年輕士兵被描繪成騎著白馬走在軍隊前方的英雄。
portray life in the city: The photographer used black-and-white pictures to portray life in the city during the 1960s.
這位攝影師用黑白照片刻畫1960年代的城市生活。
pose a threat: Plastic waste in the ocean can pose a threat to sea turtles, which often mistake it for food.
海洋中的塑膠垃圾會對海龜構成威脅，因為牠們常把它誤認成食物。
pose a question: During the interview, the reporter was allowed to pose a question to the president about the new law.
訪問中，記者獲准就新法律向總統提問。
pose a problem: Heavy traffic during rush hour can pose a problem for students who need to arrive at school early.
尖峰時段的交通擁擠，會對需要早到學校的學生造成問題。
pose for a photo: The tourists stopped in front of Taipei 101 to pose for a photo with big smiles on their faces.
遊客們在台北101前停下，面帶燦爛笑容擺姿勢拍照。
pose as a police officer: The thief would pose as a police officer to trick old people into opening their doors.
這名小偷會冒充警察，騙老人家開門。
pose a challenge: Learning to write Chinese characters can pose a challenge for foreign students, but practice makes it easier.
學寫中文字對外國學生來說可能帶來挑戰，但多練習就會變得容易。
possess a talent: Few people possess a talent for languages like hers; she can speak six of them fluently.
很少人像她一樣擁有語言才能；她能流利地說六種語言。
be possessed by fear: Alone in the dark forest, the little boy became possessed by fear and could not move at all.
獨自在黑暗的森林裡，小男孩被恐懼占據，完全動彈不得。
possess a weapon: In Taiwan, it is against the law to possess a weapon such as a gun without permission.
在台灣，未經許可持有槍枝等武器是違法的。
what possessed you?: What possessed you to swim in the sea during a typhoon? You could have been killed!
你是著了什麼魔，竟然在颱風天下海游泳？你可能會沒命的！
possess the ability: Dogs naturally possess the ability to smell things that humans cannot notice at all.
狗天生具備能力，能聞到人類完全察覺不到的氣味。
post a comment: Thousands of fans rushed to post a comment under the singer's new video on YouTube.
數千名歌迷爭相在這位歌手YouTube新影片下方張貼留言。
post a profit: Even in a difficult year, the small bakery managed to post a profit of over one million dollars.
即使在艱困的一年，這家小麵包店仍公布了超過一百萬元的獲利。
be posted abroad: My uncle, a diplomat, will be posted abroad to Japan next year, so his whole family is learning Japanese.
我叔叔是外交官，明年將派駐海外到日本，所以全家都在學日文。
post a notice: The school will post a notice on the bulletin board to tell students about the change in exam dates.
學校會在布告欄張貼公告，通知學生考試日期的變更。
keep someone posted: Please keep me posted about your trip so I know you have arrived safely.
旅途中請隨時告知我，讓我知道你已平安抵達。
